AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))), OR(NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validations)),
(Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode))) > 24999, AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "4 - Negotiate") && ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5 - Signed/PO in") ), AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(No_of_Forecast_Billing_Month__c)),
OR( Min_Of_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c < 1, ISBLANK(Min_Of_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c) ) ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Renewal')|| ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Framework')), ISBLANK(TEXT(No_of_Forecast_Billing_Month__c)), $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN', (Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode))) <= 0, /*--Bypass eComm from this VR--*/ $Label.IMExpress_Opp_Owner!= OwnerId )
